base_requirements: Canvas slice mandate: migrate the dashboard consumption surface to Inertia, React, shadcn/ui, and Tailwind while leaving unrelated internal Filament CRUD/admin in place
PRD 7: the web overview renders the canonical nine numbers followed by a problem list, and monitor detail renders incident transitions, durations, and optional annotation content
PRD 4.3 and 7: API monitors provide a live-sample JSON-path assertion builder; fetch, non-JSON, and authentication failures retain manual JSON-path entry
PRD 4.3 security: API header and token values are encrypted at rest, masked after entry, and excluded from UI responses, logs, and error reports
PRD 5.4: the web status header reports the effective global or project maintenance window and its end time

Inherited MonitorDomainContracts and StatusSummaryReadModel: use server|website|api identities, healthy|warn|down|recovering lifecycle values, warn|critical severity, canonical nine-count/freshness output, masking, and JSON schema contracts without redefining them
Inherited IncidentTimelineReadModel: monitor detail reads project-authorized ordered transitions, durations, group membership, maintenance suppression, and nullable annotation slots

Owned alerting-to-web-timeline seam: web routes/controllers and harness fixtures bind to the alerting timeline read model and prove the binding across real HTTP, relay, queue worker, and Inertia HTTP response

Canvas verification requirement: feature tests cover web routes, timeline reads, sample failures, and masking; component tests cover overview, problems, timeline, and builder states; one canonical full-runtime Playwright journey runs with the real queue worker

backend_milestone_items.title: Authorized dashboard, problem, and timeline read surface
backend_milestone_items.contract_excerpt: Within inherited ownership, register web/auth/CSRF-aware Inertia routes and thin WebDashboard controllers. Resolve the current project from the existing authenticated operator context, call the foundation StatusSummaryQuery and alerting IncidentTimelineReadModel, query a bounded cursor-paginated problem projection from shared monitor state, and adapt MaintenanceSilencer output into page props. Never accept a project override or redefine shared state/freshness/timeline schemas. Own the alerting-to-web-timeline seam wiring and testing-only loopback harness session/fixture registration in routes/web-dashboard.php; the fixture must be absent in production and enable Playwright to authenticate a deterministic project without bypassing product controller authorization. The seam proof posts results to the real alerting API, executes the registered foundation relay, runs the real queue worker, and reads the resulting timeline through the real X-Inertia monitor-detail response.

acceptance_criteria.text: Feature tests prove GET /checkybot requires the existing web operator authentication, derives exactly one authorized current project, returns the canonical nine counts/freshness plus effective maintenance banner props, defaults problems to warn/down/recovering, applies validated type/state/severity/monitor UUID filters, and cursor-paginates without leaking another project's monitors.

Feature tests prove GET /checkybot/monitors/{type}/{monitor_uuid} returns 404 for unknown or wrong-type monitors, 403 for a foreign project, and for an authorized monitor returns ordered transitions with open/final durations, incident-group membership, maintenance-suppression flags, and nullable annotation slots matching IncidentTimelineReadModel.

A Pest end-to-end test proves the owned alerting-to-web-timeline seam by posting three confirming monitor results through POST /__harness/alerting/results, executing the registered foundation outbox relay, running the real queue worker, authenticating through the testing-only web harness fixture, and observing the resulting down transition and incident group in the real GET /checkybot/monitors/{type}/{monitor_uuid} X-Inertia response, without invoking the result processor, transition service, timeline read model, or controller directly.

backend_milestone_items.title: Secure API assertion builder and live sample endpoints
backend_milestone_items.contract_excerpt: Within inherited ownership and migration range, persist one project-scoped, versioned API-builder configuration per API monitor with ordered assertions and encrypted header values using foundation secret value objects. Keep ApiMonitorBuilderController transport-only; actions/DTOs, JSON-path extraction, outbound sample policy, and the injectable bounded HTTP client live under app/Domain/ApiMonitorBuilder. GET and save responses expose only fixed masks. preserve|set|remove header semantics prevent masked placeholders from overwriting secrets, and optimistic versions prevent stale writes. The sample client revalidates every redirect/DNS result, blocks SSRF targets in production, caps time/redirects/body size, parses JSON only, emits canonical selectable JSON paths, and returns typed redacted fallback errors for transport, timeout, non-JSON, and upstream 401/403. A deterministic harness-only sample upstream may be explicitly allowlisted and must not exist in production.

acceptance_criteria.text: Migration, unit, and feature tests prove each API monitor has one project-scoped versioned builder configuration; set header values are ciphertext at rest, preserve leaves ciphertext unchanged, remove deletes it, stale versions return 409 atomically, and no GET/save response, exception, query log, application log, or serialized model contains plaintext or more than the fixed mask.

Feature tests through POST /checkybot/api-monitors/{monitor_uuid}/sample prove an authorized bounded JSON response returns status, latency, parsed JSON, and deterministic canonical JSON-path/type/preview choices, while valid preserved encrypted headers are decrypted only for the outbound request and never returned.

Failure-path feature tests prove malformed or unsafe URLs and redirects are rejected before connection, timeout/transport/non-JSON/upstream-401-or-403 responses return the declared redacted fetch_timeout|fetch_failed|non_json|upstream_auth error with manual_entry=true, response limits are enforced, and credentials or upstream bodies never appear in responses or logs.

Table-driven unit and feature tests prove PUT /checkybot/api-monitors/{monitor_uuid}/assertions accepts and preserves order for valid status, latency, and chained JSON-path operators, rejects invalid path grammar, kind/operator/operand combinations, duplicate header names, more than 50 headers or assertions, and foreign-project access, and performs no partial write on any 403, 409, or 422 response.

frontend_milestone_items.title: Inertia overview, filtered problems, timeline, and maintenance UI
frontend_milestone_items.contract_excerpt: Within inherited resources/js and CSS ownership, implement the consumption surface as Inertia React pages using shadcn/ui composition and Tailwind design tokens, not Filament widgets or duplicated server enums. Build reusable CheckybotDashboard primitives for the 3x3 status grid, problem filters/list, maintenance banner, state/severity badges, timeline events, group membership, durations, annotations, loading/empty/error states, and accessible keyboard/focus behavior. Consume only declared props and shared generated contracts. Preserve unrelated Filament internal CRUD/admin. No screen references are owned by this slice, so behavior, responsiveness, and accessibility are authoritative rather than visual-diff evidence.

acceptance_criteria.text: Component tests prove the Inertia overview renders exactly nine labeled server/website/API by healthy/warn/down values, displays freshness without presenting stale data as healthy, and renders explicit all-healthy, problems-present, empty-project, and loading/error states from contract-valid props.

Component and navigation tests prove problem filters initialize from URL type/state/severity/monitor UUID parameters, update the Inertia query while preserving normalized selections, render only returned problems, follow each authorized detail URL, and retain the notification-provided monitor UUID filter on reload/back navigation.

Component tests prove monitor detail renders transitions in chronological order with current/open and completed durations, state/severity and maintenance-suppressed labels, incident-group members, an explicit empty timeline, and annotation slots that distinguish unavailable null values from present text.

Component tests prove an active global or project maintenance prop renders a persistent status-list header banner containing the effective scope and localized silenced-until time, while an inactive prop renders no banner; the banner remains keyboard-readable at supported responsive breakpoints.

frontend_milestone_items.title: Interactive JSON-path API assertion builder
frontend_milestone_items.contract_excerpt: Within inherited frontend ownership, implement the Inertia React assertion builder with shadcn/ui controls and Tailwind tokens. It edits endpoint/method, masked header rows, and ordered status/latency/JSON-path assertions; fetches a live sample through the declared POST route; presents a navigable JSON tree/path picker; and copies a selected canonical path into an assertion without discarding unsaved work. Header rows begin in preserve mode, reveal no stored value, and explicitly switch to replace/remove. Every sample failure keeps manual JSON-path text entry enabled and displays only the server's redacted message. Saving uses configuration_version, preserves field errors and focus, and replaces local state only with the normalized masked response.

acceptance_criteria.text: Component tests prove a successful live sample renders bounded JSON, status and latency, supports keyboard navigation through the returned path tree, and inserts the selected canonical JSON path into a new or existing ordered assertion without changing unrelated unsaved fields.

Component tests prove stored header rows render only name and fixed mask, submit preserve without a value by default, require an explicit replace action before accepting a new secret, support explicit removal, and never place a stored plaintext value in rendered DOM, component state, validation output, or test snapshots.

Component tests prove fetch_timeout, fetch_failed, non_json, upstream_auth, 409, and 422 states show the declared redacted error, retain all draft assertions and headers, and keep labeled manual JSON-path text entry and save controls usable.

Component and request tests prove users can add, reorder, edit, and remove status, latency, and JSON-path assertions; field errors map to the correct row; stale-version save prompts reload without losing the draft; and a successful save replaces rows only with the normalized masked response and incremented version.

The canonical full-runtime Playwright journey runs with the real queue worker, authenticates through the harness fixture, creates a down timeline through real alerting result APIs and the registered relay, verifies the overview/problem/detail Inertia flow and maintenance banner, then uses the real sample and save HTTP routes to pick a JSON path, preserve a masked header, save an assertion, exercise an upstream-auth manual fallback, and emit integration evidence without direct controller, processor, read-model, or component invocation.
